description: This file implements the COMRPCStarter class, which manages the activation and retry logic for a plugin via COM RPC communication. It includes methods for attempting to activate a plugin with retries and logging the process.

classes.name: COMRPCStarter
classes.description: A class responsible for starting and activating a plugin with retry logic using COM RPC.

methods.name: COMRPCStarter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the COMRPCStarter with a plugin name.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Attempts to activate the plugin, with retries and delay between attempts, logging each step.
